what: fromstr.rs builds its error message eagerly with `ok_or(format!(...))` just after Panel 27 taught that eager arguments are worked out even when not needed, which is the same trap; the plan lists ok_or_else.

fix: Use `.ok_or_else(|| format!("no colon in {s:?}"))?` and recapture, adding to the line-11 note: "`ok_or_else` takes a recipe, like `or_insert_with`, so the message is only built when the colon is missing."
